title: Estimate of an infrastructure change
description: What `qloudpulse-stack estimate` sends to POST https://api.qloudpulse.com/v1/estimates (formerly /api/report/public/estimates on app.qloudpulse.com), and what qloudpulse answers. The request carries only what sets a price: resource names stay in CI, and each resource is named by a key the client derives from it.

formatVersion.description: Version of this format. Bump only for a change an older reader would read wrongly.

tool.description: What the change was read from. Terraform and OpenTofu plans come later.

stack.description: The project and stack, such as shop/prod, from the resources' URNs (docs/adr/0133). The Pulumi stacks page lists estimates by it. Resource names are never sent.

resources.description: The resources the change creates, updates, replaces or deletes, of the catalogue's types, and those it leaves the same: every one the preview lists (with --show-sames), so that the comment can give the whole stack's cost, or at least those a changed one refers to.

notPriced.description: Resource types in the change of the catalogue's providers but not in its types, with how many of each.

key.description: r + the first 16 hex digits of the SHA-256 of the resource's Pulumi URN. The answer names the resource by it.

change.description: same: left as it is. Answered too, with the same figure before and after and no notes, so that the client can add up what the stack costs; a changed resource that refers to it is priced with it.

type.description: The Pulumi type token, such as aws:rds/instance:Instance.

region.description: The AWS region, the first of: the resource's own region, its provider's, --region, the stack's aws:region, AWS_REGION, AWS_DEFAULT_REGION, and the region of the AWS profile in use on the machine the client runs on. Null when none of them names one; such a resource cannot be priced.

before.description: The priced attributes before the change, from the old state's inputs, and its outputs where the inputs leave one out; null for a create.

after.description: The priced attributes after the change; null for a delete. One neither side's inputs set comes from the old state's outputs; for a resource left the same, from its outputs where its inputs leave one out.

unknown.description: Priced attributes whose value after the change is known only after apply, or is a secret. Their values are not sent.

resourceId.description: The cloud ID of a resource that exists before the change. Sent only with --with-resource-ids.

references.description: For each of the catalogue's references of this type, the key of the resource it names, such as an ECS service's task definition.

catalogueQuestion.description: POST /v1/estimates/catalogue (formerly /api/report/public/estimates/catalogue): the resource types the client found in a preview, type tokens only. Open without a token.

catalogue.description: The answer to a catalogueQuestion: of the types asked, those the endpoint prices and the attributes the client sends for each, the providers whose other types are counted as not priced, and the client versions. Also what --catalogue reads from a file.

providers.description: Pulumi packages, such as aws, whose types outside the list are counted under notPriced.

free.description: Of the types asked, those AWS charges nothing for of their own, with why, from AWS's pricing pages. The client counts them as no cost: not sent, and not under notPriced.

client.description: The qloudpulse CLI releases this install expects. An older client than latest says a newer one is out; the endpoint refuses one below minimum.

attributes.description: The paths that set its price, up to four steps: a.b takes b from the object a, or from every object in the list a.

references.description: Attributes whose value is another resource, sent as that resource's key under references.

estimateId.description: Names this estimate, so the change event sent after apply can refer to it.

url.description: The estimate's page in the reports (docs/adr/0133). The client adds #names=<base64url of a JSON object of key to name> for the resources it sent, which the browser never sends to a server.

resources.description: One answer per resource sent, those left the same included (an endpoint from before 2026-11-19 left them out).

basis.description: What the figures come from: the rate the company's bill shows it pays, AWS's list price, or nothing.

reason.description: Why a resource is not priced, or what its figures leave out.

kind.description: saving: a cheaper choice from the savings catalogue. usage: what an existing resource used. info: anything else.

risk.description: How likely the change is to need work or cause trouble: a Graviton move is medium, since every image must have an arm64 build.
